reason: The cited evidence (E1) discusses ceria's role in enhancing oxygen storage and mobility, but only in the context of Pd/γ-Al2O3 and Ce-La-based systems, not ceria-doped TiO2. It provides no direct support for the key premises that ceria doping into a TiO2 support stabilizes noble metal dispersion or improves activity/durability in that specific system.
premises: Ceria doping into TiO2 enhances oxygen storage capacity and redox cycling.
Enhanced oxygen storage capacity and redox cycling stabilize finely dispersed noble metal active sites.
Stabilized noble metal sites improve catalytic activity and durability.
The proposed mechanism operates under typical automotive exhaust conditions (high temperature, redox cycles).
The effect is specific to ceria-doped TiO2 compared to undoped TiO2.
